title: omnipha/market estimates.json
description: Used-market price estimates per device variant. Estimates only, aggregated from observed listings; not offers.

currency.description: Base currency. USD is derived at display time with a dated exchange rate.

source.description: How the ranges were derived. Does not identify a marketplace or seller.

variant.description: Optional: applies to one ram/storage combination from ports variants. null = all variants.

estimate_eur.description: [low, high] observed used-price range, complete working devices

samples.description: Listings behind the estimate; null = not counted
